framework_metadata.description: Derived sensitive points calculated from three chart factors
framework_metadata.usage: Add depth and specificity to natal, horary, and electional charts

calculation_methodology.general_formula: Lot = Ascendant + Planet A - Planet B
calculation_methodology.day_night_variation: Many lots reverse for nocturnal charts
calculation_methodology.hermetic_lots: Use same formula day and night
calculation_methodology.zodiacal_position: Calculate in absolute longitude, convert to sign/degree
calculation_methodology.house_position: Note which house the calculated lot falls in
calculation_methodology.interpretation: Lot's house position shows where that life area manifests

calculation.example: If ASC 15° Aries, Moon 20° Taurus, Sun 10° Gemini (day): 15 + 50 - 70 = -5 = 355° = 25° Pisces

meaning.primary: Material fortune, body, health, external success
meaning.secondary: What the universe gives you, natural gifts and advantages
meaning.keywords: Luck, prosperity, health, inheritance, physical body

interpretation_by_house.1st_house: Personal magnetism, natural luck, health and vitality, success through self
interpretation_by_house.2nd_house: Financial luck, natural resources, earns money easily, values aligned with fortune
interpretation_by_house.3rd_house: Lucky in communication, siblings bring fortune, local opportunities, mind as resource
interpretation_by_house.4th_house: Family brings fortune, inheritance likely, property luck, emotional foundation supports success
interpretation_by_house.5th_house: Children bring joy, creative fortune, gambling luck (use caution), romance leads to prosperity
interpretation_by_house.6th_house: Health through work, daily routines bring luck, service path to prosperity, pets beneficial
interpretation_by_house.7th_house: Partnership brings fortune, marriage improves circumstances, success through others
interpretation_by_house.8th_house: Other people's money, inheritance strong, transformation brings resources, deep connections profitable
interpretation_by_house.9th_house: Foreign travel fortunate, higher education pays off, philosophy and wisdom attract success
interpretation_by_house.10th_house: Career success, public recognition, achievement brings material reward, status and fortune linked
interpretation_by_house.11th_house: Friends bring opportunities, group involvement fortunate, hopes fulfilled, community support
interpretation_by_house.12th_house: Hidden blessings, spiritual wealth over material, fortune through solitude, karmic gifts

aspects_to_fortune.benefics: Jupiter or Venus aspecting Fortune magnifies luck and prosperity
aspects_to_fortune.malefics: Saturn or Mars aspecting Fortune creates obstacles but builds character
aspects_to_fortune.ruler: Condition of Fortune's ruler shows how fortune manifests

lot_of_fortune.zodiacal_releasing: Used as primary timing lord in Hellenistic astrology
lot_of_fortune.progressed_fortune: Can progress Lot of Fortune to time major fortune changes

lot_of_spirit.importance: Second most important lot, complement to Fortune

meaning.primary: Actions, character, will, internal development, soul's purpose
meaning.secondary: What you actively do and achieve through your own efforts
meaning.keywords: Will, character, actions, reputation, soul purpose, effort

interpretation_by_house.1st_house: Self-directed, strong will, personal agency, acts from authentic self
interpretation_by_house.2nd_house: Builds character through values, reputation based on resources, acts to acquire
interpretation_by_house.3rd_house: Thinks and communicates purposefully, sibling relationships shape character, learning is purpose
interpretation_by_house.4th_house: Private inner work, family shapes character, emotional intelligence as purpose
interpretation_by_house.5th_house: Creative expression as purpose, joyful action, children shape character, heart-led will
interpretation_by_house.6th_house: Character through service, work ethic defines self, health-conscious actions, daily discipline
interpretation_by_house.7th_house: Character developed through relationships, acts for others, partnership shapes will
interpretation_by_house.8th_house: Transformative will, character forged in crisis, deep psychological work, power through change
interpretation_by_house.9th_house: Philosophical character, acts on beliefs, teaching shapes identity, wisdom through experience
interpretation_by_house.10th_house: Public character, reputation earned through action, career defines purpose, visible integrity
interpretation_by_house.11th_house: Character in community, collective action, friendship shapes will, humanitarian purpose
interpretation_by_house.12th_house: Spiritual will, hidden character, acts from unconscious, sacrifice shapes soul

fortune_spirit_relationship.complementary: Fortune = what you're given, Spirit = what you do with it
fortune_spirit_relationship.balance: Integrated person has both in harmony
fortune_spirit_relationship.conflict: Square or opposition shows tension between gifts and efforts

meaning.primary: Erotic love, passionate desire, romantic attraction
meaning.keywords: Passion, sexual attraction, romantic love, desire, longing

lot_of_eros.interpretation_guidelines: Shows where and how passionate love manifests, differs from Venus (general love) by focusing on eros and desire

meaning.primary: Marriage potential, type of spouse, marriage timing

interpretation_by_house.1st_house: Early marriage, identity tied to partnership, spouse changes self-image
interpretation_by_house.7th_house: Traditional marriage house, natural placement, partnership-oriented
interpretation_by_house.10th_house: Public marriage or marriage affects career, may marry for status
interpretation_by_house.11th_house: Marry a friend, group involvement through spouse, companionate marriage

lot_of_marriage.timing: Transits and progressions to Lot of Marriage can time marriage or significant relationship events

meaning.keywords: Children, fertility, parenting, legacy through offspring

interpretation.house_position: Where children manifest in life or life area affected by children
interpretation.aspects: Jupiter/Venus aspects = fertility, Saturn/Mars aspects = challenges or delays

meaning.primary: Constraints, necessity, what cannot be avoided
meaning.keywords: Fate, necessity, unavoidable circumstances, karmic constraints

lot_of_necessity.interpretation: Shows areas of life where one faces necessary limitations or fated circumstances

meaning.primary: Courage, bravery, where one shows strength
Downfall, nemesis, where one faces greatest challenges

lot_of_nemesis.interpretation: Not purely negative—shows where one must work hardest, karmic lessons

meaning.primary: Foundation of life, core security, fundamental support

lot_of_exaltation.note: 19° Aries is Sun's degree of exaltation

meaning.primary: Death, endings, transformation, what must die

lot_of_death.ethical_note: Never predict actual death time—interpret as psychological death/rebirth
lot_of_death.interpretation: Area of life requiring transformation or letting go

lot_of_reputation.meaning: Public reputation, how others see achievements

lot_of_divorce.note: Active by transit can indicate relationship stress

lot_of_sickness.meaning: Health vulnerabilities, chronic illness areas, vitality challenges

lot_of_surgery.meaning: Surgery, invasive medical procedures, cuts and wounds

lot_of_death_and_killing.ethical_note: Use with extreme caution and never for prediction

lot_of_debt.meaning: Debt, financial obligations, what is owed

lot_of_god.meaning: Divine connection, spiritual identity, relationship with God/Source

lot_of_daemon.meaning: Guardian spirit, spiritual guide, inner genius
lot_of_daemon.note: Ancient concept of personal guardian spirit, not demonic

lot_of_accusation.meaning: Legal troubles, accusations, conflicts with authority

lot_of_passion.meaning: Passion, desire, what drives you emotionally

priority_analysis: 1. Calculate Fortune and Spirit first—these are foundational
2. Add relevant life-area lots based on question (marriage lot for relationship question)
5. Check lot's ruler (who governs this area)
6. Check aspects to lot (activations and influences)

ruler_of_lot.description: The planet ruling the sign the lot falls in governs that area
ruler_of_lot.example: Lot of Marriage in Taurus—Venus rules marriage matters
ruler_of_lot.interpretation: Examine that planet's condition, house, aspects to understand lot's expression

aspects_to_lots.tight_orbs: Use 3-5° orbs for aspects to lots
aspects_to_lots.angles: Lots conjunct angles are most powerful

timing_with_lots.transits: Outer planet transits to lots can time events in that life area
timing_with_lots.progressions: Progressed planets to lots activate that area
timing_with_lots.solar_returns: Lot positions in solar return show annual themes
timing_with_lots.profections: Profection year to house containing important lot activates that area

synastry_with_lots.fortune_fortune: Comparing Fortune positions shows material compatibility
synastry_with_lots.spirit_spirit: Comparing Spirit positions shows purpose alignment
synastry_with_lots.marriage_planets: Partner's planets to your Lot of Marriage shows marriage dynamics
synastry_with_lots.cross_lots: Partner's Venus to your Lot of Eros shows romantic activation

horary_usage.fortune: Always calculate in horary for material outcomes
horary_usage.specialized_lots: Use lots specific to question (Lot of Commerce for business question)

electional_usage.favorable_placement: Place relevant lots in strong houses for elections
electional_usage.example: Lot of Marriage in 7th house for wedding election

derived_lots.example: Lot of Children from Lot of Marriage: Marriage + Jupiter - Saturn

lot_releasing.description: Zodiacal releasing from Spirit used for timing in Hellenistic astrology

annual_profections_to_lots.description: Profecting important lots through houses for annual themes

modern_lot_variations.note: Some modern astrologers create new lots for contemporary issues
modern_lot_variations.examples: Lot of Social Media, Lot of Cryptocurrency, etc.
modern_lot_variations.caution: Use traditional lots first, modern variations experimental

natal_consultation.add_as_relevant: Marriage, Children, Profession based on client questions

relationship_reading.use: Lot of Eros, Marriage, Wedding, Divorce (carefully)

career_reading.use: Lot of Profession, Accomplishment, Reputation, Commerce

timing_consultation.method: Transit and progression to relevant lots

fortune_calculation.interpretation: Lot of Fortune in 12th house Pisces—fortune through spiritual matters, hidden blessings

spirit_calculation.interpretation: Lot of Spirit in 2nd house Taurus—purpose involves building material security and values
